title: Pharmaceuticals - Worldwide
highlights: The projected revenue in the Pharmaceuticals market is estimated to reach US$1.27tn in 2026.
Among the various markets, Oncology Drugs is expected to be the largest, with a projected market volume of US$232.50bn in 2026.
Looking ahead, the revenue in this sector is anticipated to exhibit an annual growth rate (CAGR 2026-2031) of 4.73%, resulting in a market volume of US$1.60tn by 2031.
When comparing globally, it is noteworthy that United States is expected to generate the highest revenue of US$694.83bn in 2026.
The Pharmaceuticals market encompasses various countries worldwide.
Due to its advanced healthcare infrastructure and strong R&D capabilities, the United States remains at the forefront of pharmaceutical innovation worldwide.
